domestic_retest.command: for i in $(seq 1 30); do for u in https://xiu-ci.com/ https://xiu-ci.com/api/health https://xiu-ci.com/fhd-api/api/health https://xiu-ci.com/api/work-orders/customer-candidate https://xiu-ci.com/fhd-staging-api/health https://xiu-ci.com/download-release.json https://xiu-ci.com/releases/stable/enterprise/latest-mac.yml; do curl -s -o /dev/null -m 10 -w "$(date -u +%FT%TZ) %{http_code} %{remote_ip} %{content_type} %{time_total}s $u\n" "$u"; done; sleep 60; done | tee xiu-ci-domestic-probe.log
domestic_retest.pass: 前四个地址依次为 200 text/html、200 application/json、200 application/json、401 application/json，30 轮无 000/502/504；staging 与发布指针应为 JSON/YAML，若为 text/html 记为未提供
